news.title: MIT 访谈回顾 AI 对复杂人类思维的建模历史
news.body: 历史学者讨论早期研究者为何把随机性引入逻辑计算，并将其与创造力和可预测性的权衡联系起来。这是历史研究与解释视角，不是证明所有现代幻觉都无法避免的技术结论。
news.title_original: Q&A: How AI came to model the “messy” human mind
news.body_original: Assistant Professor Benjamin Lindquist studies how engineers deliberately injected randomness into early AI, giving rise to deep-learning models that sometimes hallucinate.

news.title: OpenAI 与波兰 NASK 探索 AI 安全研究合作
news.body: 双方签署协议，拟共同研究能力评估、潜在漏洞与防护机制。合作方向与既有安全案例不代表所有新系统已经获得独立安全认证。
news.title_original: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK partner to advance AI safety and security
news.body_original: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK are partnering on AI safety, security, and technical research to strengthen safeguards and support a more resilient digital ecosystem.

news.title: TorchNeuron 提供 Trainium 模型兼容性查询
news.body: 支持页面列出指定软件版本下的测试结果、运行脚本、编译在内的耗时与显存。尚未测试不等于不兼容，当前覆盖的任务与模型范围仍有限。
news.title_original: Does Your Model Run on AWS Trainium? Look It Up

news.title: ThinkingBox 把数据库最终状态检查用作训练奖励
news.body: 团队用基准之外的任务训练智能体，通过可执行结果评价完成情况。报告提升来自指定模型与训练配置，不能等同于所有真实业务任务都可靠完成。
news.title_original: Turning Database Grading into RL Rewards: Post-Training Agents with ThinkingBox

news.title: OpenAI 宣布 Decisions API 正式可用
news.body: 服务面向分类、路由等答案范围有限的决策，支持文本、图像和结构化输入。速度与成本优势取决于任务和比较条件，仍应评估错误及低置信度情况。
news.title_original: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
news.body_original: Fast, focused, low-cost decisions for any application.

news.title: X-Hinges 为交互式打印物件嵌入传感与导线
news.body: 软件将不同材料用于传感器和连接线路，以减少信号干扰，支持响应动作的打印物件原型。文中的感知能力不意味着设备具有意识，实际精度仍需按设计验证。
news.title_original: This design software reimagines everyday objects as self-aware devices
news.body_original: “X-Hinges” helps design and 3D print items like lamps and gloves with an interactive twist: automatically embedded sensors that perceive and adaptively respond to human contact.

news.title: OlmoEarth 1.3 开放全球年度卫星嵌入
news.body: 团队提供十米像素的预计算特征与浏览器地图探索工具，支持相似区域检索等用途。嵌入是可复用表征，具体土地分类或变化判断仍需任务验证。
news.title_original: OlmoEarth v1.3: State-of-the-art embeddings for the whole planet

news.title: Granite 用四种时间序列模型集成预测
news.body: 方案组合四种互补架构，提供中位数与分位数预测，无需重训或拟合集成权重。不同序列仍需比较表现，首次运行需下载成员模型。
news.title_original: Ensemble forecasting with IBM Granite time-series models

news.title: OpenAI 介绍面向客户场景的前线部署工程
news.body: 文章强调从业务结果出发，连接客户、产品与研究团队，缩小模型能力和可用系统之间的差距。案例反映团队实践，不是对所有企业部署效果的保证。
news.body_original: What forward deployed engineering means at OpenAI

news.title: Uber 宣布向全体员工推广 ChatGPT Work
news.body: 公告称从千人试点扩大到三万多名员工，并配套批准的集成、技能库与培训。推广规模不等于所有员工已经使用，也不能据此推断实际生产率收益。
news.title_original: Uber brings ChatGPT Work to all employees with OpenAI
news.body_original: Uber is rolling out ChatGPT Work to more than 30,000 employees, helping teams research, analyze data, create presentations, and complete complex workflows.

news.title: OpenAI 推动跨服务一致的安全标准
news.body: 公告要求合作伙伴维持相应防护与协同执行，并宣布使用政策更新将于 11 月 20 日生效。不能把未来生效的要求写成今日已经实施。
news.body_original: How OpenAI works with distribution partners to uphold consistent safeguards, support responsible access, and clarify expectations in our Usage Policies.

news.title: Kumo Relational 用历史上下文预测关系型数据
news.body: 预训练模型直接利用数据库关系与历史样本进行推断，无需每项任务单独训练。报告结果来自指定基准，不能外推为所有企业数据上的领先表现。
news.title_original: NVIDIA Kumo Relational Outperforms Supervised Machine Learning on Relational Data, No Training Required

news.title: VocabX 通过词表专门化降低特定推理成本
news.body: 案例针对葡萄牙语作文评分模型调整词表，报告该部署推理成本下降。效果依赖语言、任务和工作负载，不能泛化为所有小模型都节省相同比例。
news.title_original: How Specializing the Vocabulary of SLMs Can Cut Inference Cost by 77% in Real Applications

news.title: AT&T 探索用 AI 连接企业法律知识
news.body: 合作基于 LegalEdge，计划以自然语言受理请求并关联先例、研究与历史工作。部分能力仍属规划，法律判断与决策继续由专业人员负责。
news.title_original: How AT&T is rethinking in-house legal work with OpenAI
news.body_original: AT&T is working with OpenAI to make legal knowledge easier to access. Learn how its LegalEdge team is rethinking intake and scaling legal judgment.

news.title: AI 辅助超声研究探索基层孕期评估
news.body: 研究利用低成本探头与非超声专业人员采集的扫查数据估计孕周，并开展前瞻性多中心验证。研究结果不等于替代完整产检或所有超声诊断。
news.title_original: Empowering frontline maternal care with AI-assisted ultrasound

papers.title: 扩散模型生成增材制造微结构并探索逆向设计
papers.body: arXiv:2610.30404v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Metal additive manufacturing (AM) offers substantial advantages to the fabrication of complex structural components, but its widespread adoption is slowed due to complexities in the process-structure-property relations which is the cause for uncertainty and drives risk. Accurately quantifying these complex relations solely via experimental workflows is time consuming and costly. Integrated computational materials and engineering (ICME) frameworks address this challenge by leveraging advanced computational tools, such as crystal plasticity finite element models (CPFEM), to predict critical mechanical properties directly from microstructural data
papers.summary: 预印本摘要：研究用扩散模型合成具有取向信息的金属增材制造微结构，并以无分类器引导探索性能或工艺到结构的映射。数字孪生保真度与不确定性案例不等于完成实物构件认证。
